title: Training Notes: Marlowe Rewards Member Treatment of Fees in Store Credit Recoveries
content:
**What is the member treatment?** In a Gift Cards & Store Credit recovery of instant Return Store Credit, the recovery's fee part (the restocking and missing-box fees it includes), once any absorbed share is taken off, receives the member treatment of the customer's Marlowe Rewards tier and recent purchasing.

**Which members receive it, and how is the fee part treated?**

| Marlowe Rewards tier | Earning postings for dispatched orders on the membership in the last 12 months | Treatment of the fee part |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Icon or Atelier | 6 or more | Multiplied by 0.5 and rounded down to the whole dollar |
| Silver or Gold | 3 or more | Multiplied by 0.75 and rounded up to the cent |
| Any other combination | — | Kept as it stands |

**What counts as an earning posting?** A points posting on the Marlowe Rewards membership for a dispatched order. The postings counted are those dated in the last 12 months, that is fewer than 12 whole months before the recovery date.

**Do both conditions have to hold?** Yes. The tier and the number of postings are read together:

| Hypothetical member | Postings in the last 12 months | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum | 7 | Multiplied by 0.5, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| Platinum | 5 | Kept as it stands |
| Gold | 6 | Multiplied by 0.75, rounded up to the cent |
| Silver | 2 | Kept as it stands |
| Member (entry tier) | 10 | Kept as it stands |

**How do the roundings work on figures?** (hypothetical fee parts)

- Platinum, 7 postings, fee part 13.00: 13.00 multiplied by 0.5 is 6.50, rounded down to the whole dollar gives 6.00.
- Gold, 3 postings, fee part 13.00: 13.00 multiplied by 0.75 is 9.75, which needs no rounding.
- Silver, 4 postings, fee part 6.63: 6.63 multiplied by 0.75 is 4.9725, rounded up to the cent gives 4.98.
